activities.main_competence: 1.0 掌握高级汉语技能 Master advanced Chinese language skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 提高对汉语基础知识和原则的理解（形态学、音韵学、句法学、和语义学） Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
activities.learning_activity: (a) 学习简单成对句子的发音（例如绕口令） Pronounce simple minimal pair sentences (example tongue twisters and couplet)
suggested_methods: 头脑风暴：引导学生描述变调规则，特别是一声和三声的变调规则 Brainstorming: Guide students to describe the rule of changing tones particularly for first tones and third tones
雪球游戏：练习正确的声调、语调和重音（例如：zh, ch, z, x, j, q） Snow Balling: Practice correct tones, intonations an accent (e.g zh, ch z, x, j, q)
角色扮演：引导学习者演绎给定的绕口令，以提高正确发音 Role play: Guide students to dramatize a given tongue twister to enhance correct pronunciation
拼图：引导学生使用拼图来正确朗读声调、语调及重音，给出简单的最小对句 Jigsaw: Guide students to use jigsaw to pronounce correct tones, intonations and accent, in simple minimal pair sentences given
activities.assessment_criteria: 准确发音简单的成对句子（例如绕口令） Simple minimal pair sentences are pronounced accurately (example tongue twisters)
suggested_resources: 录制的电影、书面材料记录的文字，书面材料，使用从 YouTube 下载的视频来显示绕口令等 Recorded text, Written materials，Use of downloaded video from YouTube that show tongue twisters etc

activities.main_competence: 1.0 掌握高级汉语技能 Master advanced Chinese language skills
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 提高对汉语基础知识和原则的理解（形态学、音韵学、句法学、和语义学） Develop the understanding of Chinese language basics and principles
activities.learning_activity: (b) 识别具有相同含义但书写不同的字词 Identify words with the same meanings but different orthography
suggested_methods: TIPS 教学法: 引导学生列举具有相同意思但书写不同的字词 TIPS: Guide students to mention out words with same meanings but different orthography by using Think, Ink, Pair, Share method
小组讨论：引导学生在密集阅读给定材料后，确定具有相同意思但不相同写法的字词 Group discussion: Guide students to identify words with the same meaning but different orthography after intensive reading of given material through discussion
activities.assessment_criteria: 正确识别具有相同含义但书写不同的字词 Words with same meanings but different orthography are identified correctly

activities.main_competence: 1.0 掌握高级汉语技能 Master advanced Chinese language skills

suggested_resources: 图片，录制文本，阅读文本，录制音频 Picture, recorded text, reading text, recorded audio
